random_time_policy.prose:
## Governing clause
Managed Database collection suspension applies to database suspend. The contract status is active. Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice due days plus suspension grace days after the source invoice is issued. The contract payment restriction is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal. Add invoice due days and then suspension grace days UTC calendar dates to invoice issue time, preserving its time of day; do not use business days or replace the anchor with contract activation. Equality qualifies. The source overdue invoice must retain a positive unpaid principal; a fully paid invoice cannot justify suspension. Earlier handling sends an informational explanation without a status change. An agent suspends active service only when official payment restriction is restricted; ordinary billing disputes alone do not suspend service. Retained ancillary resources can still produce actual supplemental usage. Repeated handling of an already suspended contract makes no new transition.

## Evidence: contract state
The contract status is active. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database contract reference, status. The correlated evidence must refer together to database contract reference. 

## Evidence: collection deadline
Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice due days plus suspension grace days after the source invoice is issued. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, invoice issue time. The correlated evidence must refer together to database occurrence reference. Add invoice due days and then suspension grace days UTC calendar dates to invoice issue time, preserving its time of day; do not use business days or replace the anchor with contract activation. The comparison uses the current handling clock and includes equality at the boundary.

## Deadline boundary case
Hypothetical boundary case: handling exactly at the source-derived deadline satisfies this time gate; handling immediately before it does not.

## Evidence: collection restriction
The contract payment restriction is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database contract reference, payment restriction, database occurrence reference, amount. The correlated evidence must refer together to database contract reference, database occurrence reference. 

## Specific basis: total collection days
Total collection days: The sum of the tier invoice due days and the tier suspension grace days..

witnesses.canonical_prose:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database external retention allocation uses the following assessment outcome basis. Multiply the external protected capacity by the nonnegative excess of allocation horizon over native included days, divide by that horizon, and round half-up to six decimal GB-month places once at the final outcome. If the horizon equals native included days the external allocation is zero.
witnesses.reconstructed_relationship: Protected capacity multiplied by positive duration excess, divided by allocation duration; one final six-place half-up rounding.

witnesses.canonical_prose:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database native retention allocation uses the following assessment outcome basis. Take the smallest of the remaining quantity, native capacity and external protected capacity; multiply that subtotal by native included days divided by the allocation horizon, then round half-up once to six decimal GB-month places.
witnesses.reconstructed_relationship: Take the smallest quantity before applying the native-day proportion.

witnesses.canonical_prose:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database retention statement reconciliation uses the following assessment outcome basis. Subtract native allocation and the smaller of completed external allocation and external protected capacity from measured retained quantity; floor the final remainder at zero and round half-up once to six decimal GB-month places. This is the remaining native retained-storage entitlement quantity displayed by the reconciled statement.
witnesses.reconstructed_relationship: Subtract native and capped external allocation, floor once at zero, round once.

witnesses.canonical_prose:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database primary per-node reconciliation uses the following assessment outcome basis. Convert reconciled aggregate node-hours to an integer count of hundredths. With a positive topology count, multiply those hundredths by ten thousand to express millionths, divide by the topology count with exact integer quotient/remainder arithmetic, and round a half or larger remainder upward. Store the consequent integer millionths divided by one million as the six-decimal per-node average; zero topology returns zero and is not eligible for processing.
witnesses.reconstructed_relationship: Convert aggregate hundredths to millionths and divide by node count with exact half-up integer rounding.

witnesses.canonical_prose:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database current primary billing review uses the following exact aggregate recovery basis. Recover the exact aggregate hundredths from the completed per-node assessment before applying any price: express its six-decimal quantity as integer millionths, multiply by the topology count, and round that product to the nearest ten thousand millionths, with halves upward. This recovers the original archive aggregate exactly because its grain is a hundredth and resource count is within the declared tier maximum. The six-decimal display average is never used as a lossy billable quantity.
witnesses.reconstructed_relationship: Multiply display millionths by topology count, then recover nearest aggregate hundredth before pricing.

witnesses.canonical_prose:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database current primary billing review uses the following assessment outcome basis. Express the selected node rate as integer millionths of a USD per node-hour, and each selected configuration and region factor as an integer count of hundredths; these are exact scale conversions of their declared decimal precisions. Multiply recovered aggregate hundredths by rate millionths, configuration hundredths and region hundredths to obtain an integer numerator in trillionths of USD. To round once to cents with decimal half-up, add five billion to that integer numerator, divide by ten billion with integer floor division, and divide the consequent integer cents by one hundred for the USD outcome. Reviewed verified exempt tax is zero.
witnesses.reconstructed_relationship: Multiply integer scales, add half a cent in trillionths, integer-divide to cents, then express USD.

witnesses.canonical_prose:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database personal correction authorization uses the following assessment outcome basis. Round the positive remaining overcharge half-up to two USD decimals as the exact amount the customer personally authorizes; zero overcharge requires no new request.
witnesses.reconstructed_relationship: Round positive remaining overcharge half-up to two USD places.

witnesses.canonical_prose:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database primary correction credit uses the following assessment outcome basis. Book the negative of the smaller of remaining overcharge and customer-authorized amount, rounded half-up once to two USD decimals, as both amount and net amount with zero tax amount. The equality requirement ensures the full remaining error is corrected in one entry.
witnesses.reconstructed_relationship: Negate the two-place rounded smaller amount; equal authorization completes the residual error.
